subject: John Candy
hook: JOHN CANDY IS NOT WHO YOU THINK
angle: John Candy originally aspired to be a professional football player, but he was forced to abandon this dream after sustaining a career-ending knee injury during high school.
angle_support: Before considering acting, Candy dreamed of becoming a professional football player, which he was forced to abandon after a career ending knee injury in high school.
Candy attended Neil McNeil Catholic High School, where he was the treasurer of the student council, a star offensive tackle on the football team, and a member of the drama club.
title: The High School Injury That Created John Candy
description: Before headlining iconic comedy classics, John Candy set his sights on an athletic future on the football field. A devastating high school injury halted his sports path and rerouted him toward acting. Here is the untold turning point behind the beloved performer.
narration: JOHN CANDY IS NOT WHO YOU THINK You picture a born comic whose massive physical presence was built purely for slapstick, warmth, and Hollywood laughter. You assume the stage was always his natural calling. But show business was never his primary objective. Long before cinema audiences ever met him, his ambition belonged entirely to the gridiron. At Neil McNeil Catholic High School in Toronto, Candy lined up as a standout offensive tackle. He did not dream of movie sets or sketch stages. He trained relentlessly to play professional football. That future vanished in a single instant when a severe knee injury during high school crushed his athletic ambitions. Forced off the field, he studied journalism in college and pivoted to theatre instead, later even co-owning the Grey Cup champions. The warm comedy legend Hollywood came to love existed only because a ruptured joint destroyed a gridiron career.
